editorial: Midnight in an abandoned manor feels like a trap waiting to be sprung. Nosferatu (2024) delivers a dark horror that turns classic gothic obsession into an intimate claustrophobia, using the silence of shadow as a second protagonist. Joaquin Phoenix carries every scene with almost no dialogue, turning each heartbeat into a tentative dare. If you thrive on psychological thrillers that bend time and keep the edge sharp, this film will awaken the darkest corners of your mind.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of psychological thrillers who enjoy non-linear storytelling.
